title: A right one-coboundary cups to a level two-boundary
statement: Let k be a field, G a group, Ω=AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r:G→Autℚ(Ω) a group homomorphism, and A,B,N k-representations of G. Let E₀⊆Ω be a rational intermediate field finite-dimensional over ℚ such that r(s) fixing E₀ implies s·b=b for every b∈B. Let φ:A→ₗ[k]B→ₗ[k]N satisfy φ(s·a,s·b)=s·φ(a,b) for all s,a,b. Fix a one-cocycle f:G→A satisfying f(st)=s·f(t)+f(s), and fix b∈B. Assume f is level: some finite-dimensional rational intermediate field Ff⊆Ω satisfies f(sh)=f(s) whenever r(h) fixes Ff. Define d₀b(t)=t·b−b. Then cupCochain φ f (d₀b) belongs to levelCoboundaries₂ r N, the image of the level one-cochains under d₁v(s,t)=s·v(t)−v(st)+v(s).
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (E₀ : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), FiniteDimensional ℚ E₀ → (∀ s : G, r s ∈ E₀.fixingSubgroup → ∀ b : B, B.ρ s b = b) → ∀ φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N, (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∀ (f : groupCohomology.cocycles₁ A) (b : B), groupCohomology.IsLevelConstant₁ r (⇑f) → groupCohomology.cupCochain φ (⇑f) (fun t : G => B.ρ t b - b) ∈ groupCohomology.levelCoboundaries₂ r N
